protocol.coadaptation_metric: paired mean prequential reward of joint_adaptive minus learner_only; this is partner-learning uplift, not causal IA

conditions.learner_only: agent 0 learns and agent 1 is frozen

protocol.interaction: one uninterrupted predict-act-observe-update life with no replay or task-boundary callback
protocol.open_ablation: A same-state-budget joint learner with aliased context values is not in this frozen protocol. It requires a newly preregistered, disjoint evidence set before supporting a context-memory uplift claim.

seed_roles.rule: thresholds were frozen after seeds 0-29; promoted evidence uses disjoint seeds 30-59 without retuning

protocol.supported_claim: fixed-memory online coadaptation and retention in a visibly cued two-agent A-B-A sanity benchmark

operational_diagnostics.digest_exclusion_reason: host environment and measured wall-clock timing are retained for inspection but are not deterministic scientific evidence
